claims.evidence: Project record organism NEWT:9606; MaxQuant search against reviewed human UniProt. Note reconcile flags Mus musculus only because of goat-anti-mouse Dynabeads in the protocol (false positive).

claims.value: CD14+ monocyte, CD4 T, CD8 T, CD19 B, CD56 NK
claims.evidence: Description lists CD14, CD4, CD8, CD19, CD56 enrichment; run names carry the marker. Mapping of markers to CL cell types (CD4/CD8 to alpha-beta T cell, CD19 to B cell, CD56 to NK cell) is inferred.

claims.location: characteristics[treatment status], factor value[treatment status], characteristics[treatment]
claims.value: pre-treatment (no '4month' in run name) vs on treatment (tocilizumab, '4month' in run name)
claims.evidence: Title/description: tocilizumab treatment; run names with and without '4month'. Baseline = unlabelled runs is INFERRED from naming; no paper/explicit sampling table available.
Replicate numbers taken from run names; whether they are technical or biological replicates is not stated (single patient, one draw => treated as technical).
Protocol text names Q Exactive Plus; archive dropdown says Q Exactive (MS:1001911). Text outranks dropdown.
Protocol: overnight trypsin digestion. MaxQuant enzyme setting Trypsin/P, max 2 missed cleavages (search parameter, not recorded as the digest).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Acetyl Protein N-term, Oxidation M, Deamidated N/Q/R (MaxQuant Deimidation NQR; protocol: deamidation NQ and citrullination R), Phospho STY variable
claims.evidence: parameters.txt Fixed modifications and summary.txt Variable modifications
MaxQuant first/main search precursor tolerance not recorded in parameters.txt
Protocol: 12 mM TCEP and 40 mM iodoacetamide
Protocol: up to 12 precursors for HCD fragmentation
Top-N selection by intensity; label-free quantification (PRIDE quantification method label-free)
All 30 RAW entries in file list, each with projectAccessions containing PXD002686; one file per row, no fractionation

limitations: No publication (no DOI/references in PRIDE record); no paper Methods or supplementary available.
Sex not stated; ancestry not stated.
Baseline vs 4 month assignment and replicate nature inferred from run names.
PRIDE experimentTypes says Top-down proteomics, contradicted by bottom-up trypsin digestion protocol; ignored.
RAW file headers not read (no raw metadata verification of instrument or acquisition).
